page.layout: The scan is rotated 90 degrees; the text reads from bottom to top. One bookplate page in a double-ruled frame. On the left, the large blackletter title in two lines. At the top centre, a circular portrait medallion. Right of centre, two lines of spaced capitals above a line of capitals, with "SHELF No:" beside an engraving of a building at the lower right. The handwritten shelf mark is not transcribed.
page.notes: The page is rotated 90 degrees on the scan; transcribed in the order of reading once turned upright. Engraving: a circular oval portrait medallion of a man in profile, above the title on the left side of the frame, and a line engraving of a multi-storey brick building with a tree at the lower right, beside the shelf line. The handwritten shelf mark "ADAMS 264.27" in ink is not printed text and is omitted. The blackletter "Library." may read with a comma-like period; it is given as a period. No running head, page number, catchword or signature is printed.
